surface_leak: A double-counting bound n^{2-1/t} that looks improvable by a better invariant.
verdict: tight in the proved range only
why_negative: Kollar-Ronyai-Szabo norm graphs give tightness for t >= s!, improved by Alon-Ronyai-Szabo to t >= (s-1)!+1; KST is tight up to constants IN THAT RANGE ONLY. Whether KST is tight for t >= 4 is reported still open.
verification: STANDARD — not separately fetched this session
range_restriction: THE TWIN IS VALID ONLY WHERE TIGHTNESS IS PROVED: t >= (s-1)!+1. Outside that range it is not a negative, because the bound is not known tight.
